# cursor-hindsight-ondemand

> On-demand local Hindsight memory daemon for Cursor on Windows.

cursor-hindsight-ondemand starts `hindsight-embed` only when a Cursor agent session or MCP tools need memory — not at Windows logon. Traffic stays on `http://127.0.0.1:9077` so a cold start does not fall through to Hindsight Cloud.

**Use this repo when:** you want local Cursor agent memory without a 24/7 Startup daemon.  
**Do not use this repo for:** model routing YAML, or GitNexus code graphs.  
**Pair with:** public [cursor-model-orchestrator](https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-model-orchestrator) **stack** profile for soft Hindsight `retain` (MCP server name `hindsight`). This repo is lifecycle only, not the model router.

## Quick facts

- Platform: Windows + PowerShell (+ Python hooks, Node/`npx` for MCP)
- Local API: `http://127.0.0.1:9077` (`hindsightApiUrl` must stay local)
- MCP server name for stack: `hindsight`
- MCP entry: prefer `mcp-launch.mjs` via `node` (`examples/mcp.json`); `mcp-launch.ps1` is legacy and delegates to `.mjs` when present
- Cold start: typically 40–120s; set Cursor `sessionStart` timeout to 180
- License: MIT

## Install

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/dapetun/cursor-hindsight-ondemand.git
cd cursor-hindsight-ondemand
.\install.ps1
.\install.ps1 -WriteHooks -WriteMcp -WriteCursorJson   # optional examples
```
